learn: A 6s film as three 2s beats: fruit hook, product surface macro, lineup with logo.
The yoghurt surface itself is a plate: fruit lands in it.
A logo bug in every shot, then the big logo on the end hold.
Falling fruit on a flat colour is the simplest hook that works.
